body: Cycling is deeply ingrained in Dutch culture, and the Netherlands now has about 24 million bikes, more than its population.
骑行深深植根于荷兰文化，如今荷兰约有2400万辆自行车，比全国人口还多。
Bikes there took off in the industrial era, changing from a toy for the rich into an everyday tool for ordinary people.
自行车在工业时代迅速流行起来，从富人的玩具变成了普通人的日常交通工具。
Hot cities like Dubai are also building cycle tracks, hoping cycling can improve quality of life, though they cannot simply copy and paste the Dutch model.
迪拜等炎热城市也在修建自行车道，希望骑行能提升生活品质，但它们不能照搬荷兰模式。
Have you ever received an uncivil email that ruined your whole morning? Many office workers say rude messages cause real stress.
你有没有收到过一封没礼貌的邮件，毁掉一整个上午的心情？许多上班族说无礼的信息会带来真实的压力。
Because emails have no tone of voice or facial expressions, a short reply can easily come across as cold or angry.
因为邮件没有语气和表情，一句简短的回复很容易让人觉得冷漠甚至生气。
Experts suggest waiting before replying to an annoying email, and adding polite greetings to soften the message.
专家建议收到令人恼火的邮件先别急着回，并加上礼貌的问候语来软化语气。

articles.en: Heat, Humidity and the World Cup
articles.zh: 世界杯遭遇高温高湿考验
body: This summer's World Cup has faced extreme heat, with players competing in temperatures that push their bodies to the limit.
今夏世界杯遭遇极端高温，球员们在把身体逼到极限的气温下比赛。
High humidity makes things worse, because sweat cannot evaporate easily and the body struggles to cool down.
高湿度让情况更糟，因为汗水难以蒸发，身体很难降温。
Organisers now use cooling breaks and evening kick-offs to protect players and fans from heat stress.
主办方现在采用补水降温暂停和傍晚开球的办法，保护球员和球迷免受热应激伤害。
Supermarket shelves are full of yoghurts, but not all of them are as healthy as their labels suggest.
超市货架上摆满了各种酸奶，但并不是每一款都像标签宣传的那么健康。
Many flavoured yoghurts contain added sugar, so checking the ingredients list is smarter than trusting the packaging.
很多风味酸奶都含有添加糖，所以看配料表比相信包装宣传更聪明。
Nutritionists say plain yoghurt with live cultures is often the best choice for your gut health.
营养学家说，含活性菌的原味酸奶通常是对肠道健康最好的选择。
Many people find the sound of rain deeply relaxing, and some even play rain recordings to help them fall asleep.
很多人觉得雨声特别让人放松，有些人甚至靠播放雨声录音来帮助入睡。
Scientists explain that steady rain works like white noise, masking sudden sounds that would otherwise disturb our brains.
科学家解释说，平稳的雨声就像白噪音，能掩盖那些会打扰大脑的突发声响。
A rainy day also gives us permission to slow down, stay indoors and enjoy a quiet moment with a warm drink.
雨天还给了我们放慢脚步的理由：待在室内，捧一杯热饮，享受安静时光。
